# CareerVeda — full program reference

> CareerVeda is an Indian ed-tech company offering mentor-led postgraduate programs in product management, data analytics, data science with AI, investment banking, cybersecurity and data engineering, with placement assistance and live industry projects.

This is the long form of https://careerveda.in/llms.txt: every program in full. CareerVeda
(Career Veda, CareerVeda India, careerveda.in) is at https://careerveda.in.
Contact: Info@careerveda.in, +91 9217801191.
Fees and batch dates change between batches; each program's page is authoritative.

## PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI

URL: https://careerveda.in/programs/gen-ai-agentic-ai

Master Generative AI and agentic systems end to end — LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, autonomous agents, MCP tooling and multi-agent orchestration — through live mentor-led classes, hands-on builds and a production-ready portfolio.

- Duration: 6 Months
- Format: Live Online
- Eligibility: Freshers, Graduates, Experienced
- Fee: ₹1,45,000
- EMI: 3, 6, 9 & 12 months (No Cost EMIs)
- Next batch: September 19, 2026
- Projects: 30+

### Skills and tools

Python, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning, Agentic AI, MCP, Multi-Agent

### Curriculum modules

- Engineering Foundations
- 1. Python for AI
- 2. Maths & Data Foundations
- 3. Deep Learning & Transformers
- 4. LLM Foundations & Prompt Engineering
- 5. Building with LLM APIs
- 6. Embeddings, Vector Search & RAG
- 7. RAG Evaluation & Failure Lab
- 8. Fine-Tuning & Model Customization
- 9. Agent Engineering Fundamentals
- 10. Tool Engineering, Memory & State
- 11. Multi-Agent Systems & Orchestration
- 12. MCP, Agent Interoperability & A2A
- 13. Multimodal & Computer-Use AI
- 14. LLMOps, Security & Cost Engineering
- 15. Capstone: Production Gen AI & Agentic Platform

### Outcomes

- A portfolio of Gen AI applications, RAG systems and autonomous agents
- Readiness for AI Engineer, LLM Developer, Gen AI and Agentic AI roles
- Production confidence — evaluation, deployment, observability and cost control

### Projects and internship

- Real-World Gen AI & Agentic Projects
- LLM, RAG and Agent Builds
- MCP and Multi-Agent Platform Delivery
- Evaluation, Security & Cost Labs
- Production Deployment & Monitoring
- Industry Mentorship by Practising AI Engineers

### Questions about this program

**How long is the PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI?**
The PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI runs for 6 Months and is delivered Live Online.

**What is the fee for the PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI?**
The program investment is ₹1,45,000 (Including GST). EMI options: 3, 6, 9 & 12 months (No Cost EMIs).

**Who can join the PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI?**
It is open to: Freshers, Graduates, Experienced.

**When does the next batch of the PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI start?**

**What skills and tools does the PG Program in Gen AI and Agentic AI cover?**
Python, LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning, Agentic AI, MCP, Multi-Agent.

## PG Program in Product Management

It blends business strategy, user-centric design, technology fundamentals and data-driven decision-making, so you can bridge engineering, design, marketing and business teams.

- Fee: 1,45,000
- EMI: 3, 6, 9 & 12 months (No Cost EMIs)· Zero hidden charges

- 8. Agile Product Development
- 9. Product Analytics & Decision Science
- 10. AI for Product Managers
- 11. Product Growth & Go-to-Market Strategy
- 12. Product Leadership & Stakeholder Management
- 13. Capstone Project

### Outcomes

- A portfolio of PRDs, prototypes, analytics dashboards and a GTM plan
- Readiness for Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Product Executive and Junior PM roles
- PM interview mastery: product cases, metrics, AI product scenarios and mock interview labs

### Projects and internship

- Format: Live Online
- Eligibility: Freshers, Graduates, Experienced
- Fee: 1,65,000
- EMI: 3, 6, 9 & 12 months (No Cost EMIs)
- Next batch: September 19, 2026
- Projects: 30+

### Skills and tools

Linux, Networking, Web Safety, Monitoring, Reports

## General questions

### What programs does CareerVeda offer?

Programs span Investment Banking, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Data Science with AI/ML and Agentic AI, CyberSecurity, Backend Development Engineering, and Data Engineering with Agentic & Gen AI. Each one is built around the tools and workflows employers are hiring for right now.

### What is the duration of these programs?

Duration varies by program and by the batch you join, since each track is scoped to the depth its role demands. Our admissions team can walk you through the exact schedule for the program you're considering.

### Do I get certifications after completing the program?

Yes. You earn an industry-aligned, globally recognized certification that validates your expertise, adds credibility to your resume, and helps you stand out with employers.

### Is there placement assistance provided?

Yes — placement support runs alongside the course rather than after it: resume support, LinkedIn optimization, mock interviews, soft skills training, referrals, and direct access to our 900+ hiring partners.

### What are the eligibility criteria to enroll?

Criteria depend on the program and on your background — some tracks assume prior experience, others are built for career changers starting fresh. Talk to our admissions team and they'll tell you which programs you're eligible for.

### Is this live online program or recorded lectures?

Classes are live and interactive, taught by expert instructors with time set aside for doubt clearing. Sessions are recorded too, so you can revisit anything you need to review.

### Can I pursue this program while working full time?

Yes — the schedule is designed for working professionals. Choose weekday or weekend batches, catch up through recordings, and continue at a pace that fits around your job.

### Will AI replace humans?

AI automates tasks, not careers — the people getting hired are the ones who know how to direct it. Every CareerVeda program now teaches you to build with and alongside AI and Agentic tools, so you graduate on the right side of that change rather than competing with it.

### What kind of projects will I work on?

You build portfolio-ready projects and work through case studies drawn from real business challenges at leading companies — the kind of problems you'd face in the role, not textbook exercises.

### What is the average salary hike after completing the program?

Learners report an average salary growth of 86%. Your own outcome depends on your experience, target role, and the market you're hiring into, so treat that as a benchmark rather than a promise.

### What support is available during the program?

You're assigned a personal mentor matched to your goals, with weekly guidance sessions, a career roadmap, and progress tracking. Live classes, doubt clearing, and skill workshops run throughout, and career support continues after you graduate.

### Will I get 100% placement through CareerVeda?

No honest program can guarantee an interview outcome — hiring decisions belong to employers. What CareerVeda commits to is the full placement machinery: resume and LinkedIn polish, mock interviews, soft-skill training, referrals, and direct access to our 900+ hiring partners, with career support that continues after you graduate.
